faq.question: Q1. What is the CSB Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification by the Central Silk Board (CSB) to fill 3 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions through walk-in interviews under research projects at ISTR, Bangalore.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSB JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow positions across two projects (2 for project PPF09009MNC and 1 for project BPS09010MNC).

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for CSB Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 27 October 2026 starting at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the CSB JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at ISTR, Carmelaram post, Kodathi, Bangalore-560035.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for CSB JRF posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Life Sciences (Sericulture/ Agronomy/ Entomology/ Zoology etc.) for Project 1, or M.Sc. in Life Sciences (Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/ Botany/ Zoology/ Biology/ Food Science/ Sericulture etc.) for Project 2, with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates).

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for CSB Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the notification date, with a 5-year relaxation for SC/ST and women candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for CSB Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates with NET/GATE qualifications receive Rs. 31,000 + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 35,000 + HRA for the third year. Candidates without NET/GATE receive Rs. 21,000 + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 25,000 + HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for CSB JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Can I submit my application by post or email?
faq.answer: No, applications will not be accepted by post, e-mail, or courier. Candidates must attend the walk-in interview directly.

faq.question: Q10. Are the CSB JRF positions permanent?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely temporary, on a contractual basis, and are co-terminus with the project.
